keySentence: The frog helped her keep the promise.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The frog was kind. They spent time together. She learned about promises. The frog helped her keep the promise.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Days passed and the princess started changing her heart. The frog was always kind, polite, and cheerful. The frog helped her keep the promise she had made. He showed her what real friendship means. The princess smiled at the frog for the first time. She was becoming a better person thanks to the frog.
facts.Word cards: frog = 개구리 / helped = 도와줬다 / promise = 약속 / ball = 공
